subject: Next steps: sandbox walkthrough cadence & stakeholder sync
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmehealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 10 Jan 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: sandbox walkthrough cadence & stakeholder sync

Hi Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a proposal for next steps: 

Recap (2 min)
- You’re evaluating an embedded inference path for clinical triage routing; primary concerns are latency under 200ms p50 and data residency for logs.
- Pilot scope: 3 endpoints, synthetic workload, 30K tokens/day.

Proposed immediate next steps
1) Schedule a 60‑min sandbox walkthrough (product + tech deep dive + procurement/security Q&A).
2) Share a short mutual action plan so procurement has visibility. I’ve attached a draft (MAA_v1.xlsx).
3) Loop in your security and procurement contacts so we can surface SOC/SAML/retention details up front.

Proposed demo windows (PST):
- Tue Jan 19: 9:00–10:00 or 13:00–14:00
- Wed Jan 20: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00

Can you confirm which of the above works and who from your side should be on the call (CISO, procurement, platform)? If none of these fit, tell me two alternatives and we’ll adjust.

Thanks — I’ll leave Karthik and Marcus on copy to help scope the technical agenda.

—
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198
From: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmehealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: sandbox walkthrough cadence & stakeholder sync

Thanks, Olga — good summary.

We’d like to include:
- Ken Wu (CISO) — ken.wu@acmehealth.com
- Procurement (procurement@acmehealth.com) — they’ll want the mutual action plan and a short T&Cs overview
- Samir Patel (Platform lead) — samir.patel@acmehealth.com (platform/infra)

Our preferred windows are Wed Jan 20 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu Jan 21 09:00–10:00 PT. Wed 10:00 is ideal.

Ken is sensitive to data residency and audit logging; procurement will need a copy of the MAA and any SOC reports up front. If you can attach a short checklist of onboarding prerequisites (SAML, IP allowlist, contract lead times) that will speed approvals.

Priya
Director, Platform Partnerships
Acme Health
priya.sharma@acmehealth.com
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmehealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: sandbox walkthrough cadence & stakeholder sync

Great — thanks for the quick reply and for looping Samir and procurement. Wed Jan 20 10:00–11:00 PT is confirmed on our side; I’ve booked that tentatively on the presumption we get final confirmation from Ken.

Agenda (60 min)
- 0–15 min: product walkthrough — expected user flow and latency profile
- 15–45 min: technical deep dive with Samir and Marcus (infrastructure, SSO, KV cache behavior, quantized model profile)
- 45–60 min: security & procurement Q&A (Evelyn will cover SOC/incident posture)

Attachments: I’m re-attaching the draft mutual action plan (MAA_v1.xlsx) and a short onboarding checklist (platform_onboarding_checklist.md). Evelyn has the SOC excerpt and will attach separately.

Prep ask for Acme (one email to share with stakeholders)
- Provide any baseline SSO metadata (IdP) or let us know if we should demo SAML setup steps in the sandbox.
- Confirm whether log retention must remain in-region (yes/no).
- Procurement: any standard NDA or redline deadline we should expect prior to pilot start?

Link to shared docs: https://drive.google.com/open?id=mutual_action_plan
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deals/ACME-2027-Q1-01

If everyone is aligned I’ll finalize the calendar invite and include dial-in and the sandbox link.

—
Olga
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmehealth.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 15:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: sandbox walkthrough cadence & stakeholder sync

Hi Priya / Olga — looping in a couple of items from security so Ken has a sense of what we’ll cover during the Q&A.

Quick notes: 
- I’ve attached a SOC 2 Type II excerpt (SOC2_excerpt.pdf) that highlights our control environment and scope relevant to hosting inference workloads.
- For the sandbox walkthrough we can demo SAML IdP integration and show token/kv cache retention behavior. If Acme requires logs to stay in-region we’ll highlight our private deployment and routing options.
- Standard asks from security: brief network allowlist (CIDR) for the sandbox, expected retention window for request logs, and whether you’ll want encrypted-at-rest snapshots routed to your KMS.

Procurement/security redlines: if procurement needs a copy of our standard pilot addendum I can point them to the template; Olga — I noted your MAA will help.

I’ll join Wed Jan 20 10:00 PT and can come prepared with a short slide showing where SOC attestation covers the pilot scope.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com
From: Ken Wu <ken.wu@acmehealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@acmehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com, Samir Patel <samir.patel@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: sandbox walkthrough cadence & stakeholder sync

Thanks — Wed Jan 20 10:00 PT works for me. I appreciate the agenda and the SOC excerpt; I reviewed the attached document and have two quick asks before the call: 

1) Please add a one‑pager that lists exactly which log fields are retained in the sandbox and for how long (we need to confirm no PHI persists past anonymization).
2) Procurement: please send any standard pilot order form or DocuSign link for the MAA so we can review redlines ahead of the meeting.

Procurement team (cc’d) — can you confirm who will own the contract review and an expected turnaround time?

If you can get the one‑pager and a DocuSign link into the shared folder by EOD Mon Jan 18 that will let us move quickly.

Ken Wu
CISO, Acme Health
ken.wu@acmehealth.com
